dialogues.jp:
日が暮れるのと同時に、熱気とともに色々なも
のが夜空に吸い込まれたようだ。
dialogues.en:
As the sun went down, excitement and many other feelings
were sucked into the dark sky.
dialogues.text:
As the sun went down, excitement and many other feelings
were sucked into the dark sky.

dialogues.jp: 終わった――そんな独特の空気。
dialogues.en: Everything was over...... There was a different atmosphere.
dialogues.text: Everything was over...... There was a different atmosphere.

dialogues.jp: 運動会の後もこんなだったか。
dialogues.en: It was like this after the sports festival too.
dialogues.text: It was like this after the sports festival too.

dialogues.jp: 悪くはない。……たぶん。
dialogues.en: It's not too bad.
dialogues.text: It's not too bad.

dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　前を歩いてるのって萌先輩なんじゃ
　……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? Isn't that Moe-sempai walking ahead of me?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm? Isn't that Moe-sempai walking ahead of me?"

dialogues.jp:
｛ほの／仄｝かに星の光を反射しながら散る桜の中を、本
校の制服を着た女の子がひとり、歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
A girl was walking in the falling petals, wearing the
uniform from my school.
dialogues.text:
A girl was walking in the falling petals, wearing the
uniform from my school.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩ッ！」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
俺の声に反応して振り返ったのは、やはり萌先
輩だった。
dialogues.en: The girl who reacted to my voice was indeed Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: The girl who reacted to my voice was indeed Moe-sempai.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ご卒業、おめでとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Congratulations on your graduation."
dialogues.text: "Congratulations on your graduation."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリと微笑む先輩は、建前なんかじゃない、
本当の笑顔を見せてくれる。
dialogues.en: Her big smile isn't phony but very genuine.
dialogues.text: Her big smile isn't phony but very genuine.

dialogues.jp: 「はは、どうも」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha, thank you."

dialogues.jp: 先輩と並んだ俺は、ゆっくりと歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I walked next to her and started walking slowly.
dialogues.text: I walked next to her and started walking slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「今日はひとりなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you alone today?"
dialogues.text: "Are you alone today?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子はどうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Where's Mako?"
dialogues.text: "Where's Mako?"

dialogues.jp:
卒業日なんだし、卒パでも一緒だったのに、ど
うして一緒にいないんだろう？
dialogues.en:
They were at the graduation party together. I wonder why
she's not here with her.
dialogues.text:
They were at the graduation party together. I wonder why
she's not here with her.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「眞子ちゃんなら、後輩の女の子たちに見つか
　らないうちに急いで先に帰ってしまいました」
dialogues.en: "She went home early before the younger girls found her."
dialogues.text: "She went home early before the younger girls found her."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……なるほど」

あいつは相当人気があるらしいからな。卒パが
なかったら、それこそ卒業式が終わったとたん、
｛・・／群集｝に囲まれてしまっただろう。
dialogues.en:
I guess she's really popular. If she wasn't participating in
the graduation party, she would've been surrounded by her
fans after the graduation.
dialogues.text:
I guess she's really popular. If she wasn't participating in
the graduation party, she would've been surrounded by her
fans after the graduation.

dialogues.jp:
女子校に行ったら、新しい世界が開けるんじゃ
ないか？
dialogues.en:
She might have a new insight of the world if she went to a
girl's school.
dialogues.text:
She might have a new insight of the world if she went to a
girl's school.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、眞子はいいや。それで、占いのほうは
　どうでした？　上手くいきました？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, how was your fortune-telling? Was it a success?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, how was your fortune-telling? Was it a success?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。もうとっても楽しかったです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. It was very fun."
dialogues.text: "Yes. It was very fun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうでしょうね」
dialogues.en: "I bet."
dialogues.text: "I bet."

dialogues.jp: 心底、楽しそうでしたから。ええ、ホントに。
dialogues.en: She really did look like she was having lots of fun.
dialogues.text: She really did look like she was having lots of fun.

dialogues.jp: 「ところで、あの占いって当たるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, was that prediction really right?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, was that prediction really right?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。１発１００中です」
dialogues.en: "Yes. It's 100% right."
dialogues.text: "Yes. It's 100% right."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「…………それは、凄いですね」
dialogues.en: "............That's amazing."
dialogues.text: "............That's amazing."

dialogues.jp:
名言だ。占いというものを、一言で実によく表
している。
dialogues.en: She's calling her psychic skills 100% accurate.
dialogues.text: She's calling her psychic skills 100% accurate.

dialogues.jp: つまりそれだけ｛あいまい／曖昧｝ってことだ。
dialogues.en: That alone makes it sound suspicious.
dialogues.text: That alone makes it sound suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんは占いって信じますか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you believe in psychics, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Do you believe in psychics, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あんまり。ソレ系の事には、興味ないんです
　よね。基本的には」
dialogues.en:
"Not really. I'm not that interested in those kinds of
things."
dialogues.text:
"Not really. I'm not that interested in those kinds of
things."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ソレ系？」
dialogues.en: "Those kinds of things?"
dialogues.text: "Those kinds of things?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、占いもそうだし、超常現象とか幽霊と
　か……」
dialogues.en:
"I mean things like psychics, supernatural powers, and
ghosts......"
dialogues.text:
"I mean things like psychics, supernatural powers, and
ghosts......"

dialogues.jp:
どうしたんだろうか？　萌先輩が不意に真面目
な表情になって、俺の顔をじっと見つめてきた。
dialogues.en:
I wonder what's wrong. Moe-sempai's suddenly staring at my
face with a serious look.
dialogues.text:
I wonder what's wrong. Moe-sempai's suddenly staring at my
face with a serious look.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「幽霊は……幽霊は、きっと居ます」
dialogues.en: "I believe...... that ghosts exist."
dialogues.text: "I believe...... that ghosts exist."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「幽霊だって魂だって在りますよ」
dialogues.en: "Ghosts and spirits do exist."
dialogues.text: "Ghosts and spirits do exist."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「だって、存在しないものに、言葉はつきませ
　んから」
dialogues.en: "If there are no such things, why are there words for it?"
dialogues.text: "If there are no such things, why are there words for it?"

dialogues.jp: 何か、五感では拾えないものが変化していた。
dialogues.en: Things were becoming different around us.
dialogues.text: Things were becoming different around us.

dialogues.jp: 雰囲気、密度、緊張感……。
dialogues.en:
The atmosphere, the density, and the tension between
us......
dialogues.text:
The atmosphere, the density, and the tension between
us......

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩を起点として、それは、周りに放射され
ていて……。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai was releasing it from her body......
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai was releasing it from her body......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: (Ugh.)
dialogues.text: (Ugh.)

dialogues.jp:
次の瞬間には、萌先輩はいつもの先輩に戻って
いた。何もかも、巻き戻されたようだ。
dialogues.en:
The next moment, she was back to her normal self. Everything
was being rewound.
dialogues.text:
The next moment, she was back to her normal self. Everything
was being rewound.

dialogues.jp: 俺は内心でため息をついて、言った。
dialogues.en: I sighed inside my heart and spoke.
dialogues.text: I sighed inside my heart and spoke.

dialogues.jp: 「……お休みですか？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you going to sleep now?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you going to sleep now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい……多分、ずっと占いをしていたせいで
　すね」
dialogues.en:
"Yes...... I'm tired from playing at being a psychic all
day."
dialogues.text:
"Yes...... I'm tired from playing at being a psychic all
day."

dialogues.jp: 眠そうに｛まぶた／瞼｝を｛こす／擦｝りながら答える。
dialogues.en: She answered as she rubbed her sleepy eyes.
dialogues.text: She answered as she rubbed her sleepy eyes.

dialogues.jp:
あのテンションでずっといたのなら、そりゃ、
疲れるわな。
dialogues.en:
Of course she would be tired if she was acting like that all
day.
dialogues.text:
Of course she would be tired if she was acting like that all
day.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩の家ってどこなんです？」
dialogues.en: "Where's your house, Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Where's your house, Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「病院のそばです」
dialogues.en: "It's near the hospital."
dialogues.text: "It's near the hospital."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「病院って、あのデカイ病院ですか？」
dialogues.en: "You mean that huge hospital?"
dialogues.text: "You mean that huge hospital?"

dialogues.jp:
返事するものの、すでにほとんど眠りかけてい
る。
dialogues.en: She replied to me, but she's already half asleep.
dialogues.text: She replied to me, but she's already half asleep.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、俺が送りますから、萌先輩は眠って
　ください」
dialogues.en: "I'll walk you back home, so you can fall asleep."
dialogues.text: "I'll walk you back home, so you can fall asleep."

dialogues.jp:
そんなに遅い時間ではないとはいえ、夜道を女
の子ひとりで帰すのは男として気が引ける。特
に萌先輩の場合は眠りながら歩くわけで。
dialogues.en:
Although it's not that late yet, I can't let a girl go back
home on her own. Especially Moe-sempai, who walks in her
sleep.
dialogues.text:
Although it's not that late yet, I can't let a girl go back
home on her own. Especially Moe-sempai, who walks in her
sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい……お願いします……スー……」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... Thank you...... zzz......"
dialogues.text: "Yes...... Thank you...... zzz......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉に安心したように歩いたまま、目だけ
閉じる萌先輩。
dialogues.en:
She was relieved to hear my words, and closed her eyes while
walking.
dialogues.text:
She was relieved to hear my words, and closed her eyes while
walking.

dialogues.jp:
歩きながら女の子の寝顔を眺めるという、もは
や貴重でもなんでもなくなった体験をしつつ、
萌先輩の自宅に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I headed toward her house while looking into her sleeping
face. It's funny how I'm getting used to this situation.
dialogues.text:
I headed toward her house while looking into her sleeping
face. It's funny how I'm getting used to this situation.

dialogues.jp: 交差点の赤信号でピタリと立ち止まる萌先輩。
dialogues.en: She stopped for a red light at a intersection.
dialogues.text: She stopped for a red light at a intersection.

dialogues.jp: 「｛さすが／流石｝だ……」
dialogues.en: "She's amazing......"
dialogues.text: "She's amazing......"

dialogues.jp:
そのまま、信号が赤から青に変わったとたん、
再び歩き始める。
dialogues.en: She started walking as soon as the light turned green.
dialogues.text: She started walking as soon as the light turned green.

dialogues.jp:
そんな萌先輩の神業に見とれながら横断歩道に
足を踏み出した俺は、習慣的に右を見る。
dialogues.en:
As I was fascinated with her skill, I took a step forward
and looked to my right.
dialogues.text:
As I was fascinated with her skill, I took a step forward
and looked to my right.

dialogues.jp:
それが車のライトだと認識するより早く、萌先
輩を後ろから抱きしめるようにしながら、反対
車線に飛び込む。
dialogues.en:
Before I realized what was happening, I saw the headlights
beaming from a car. I grabbed Moe-sempai from behind and
jumped to the other side of the road.
dialogues.text:
Before I realized what was happening, I saw the headlights
beaming from a car. I grabbed Moe-sempai from behind and
jumped to the other side of the road.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「きゃっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Kyaaah!"
dialogues.text: "Kyaaah!"

dialogues.jp:
背後を車が猛スピードで走り抜ける気配――そ
の瞬間、今度は足に物凄い衝撃が走った。
dialogues.en:
When I felt the car speeding by us, I felt a sharp pain in
my leg.
dialogues.text:
When I felt the car speeding by us, I felt a sharp pain in
my leg.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……朝倉くん……どうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Um...... Asakura-kun......? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "Um...... Asakura-kun......? What happened?"

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩のきょとんとした声が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I heard Moe-sempai's surprised voice.
dialogues.text: I heard Moe-sempai's surprised voice.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「私…どう……道路に寝て…るん…しょう？」
dialogues.en: "Why are we...... lying on the street......?"
dialogues.text: "Why are we...... lying on the street......?"

dialogues.jp: 思わず、ふきだしちゃいそうだ……。
dialogues.en: I almost cracked up......
dialogues.text: I almost cracked up......

dialogues.jp: たぶん、萌先輩は大丈夫……大丈夫……。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai should be fine...... she's fine......
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai should be fine...... she's fine......

dialogues.jp: そんなことを思いながら……、
dialogues.en: As I was thinking......,
dialogues.text: As I was thinking......,

dialogues.jp: 意識が……、
dialogues.en: My consciousness was......
dialogues.text: My consciousness was......

dialogues.jp: ◆幽霊はきっと……◆
dialogues.en: ◆Ghosts do exist......◆
dialogues.text: ◆Ghosts do exist......◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩と帰りが一緒になった。
dialogues.en: I was going back home with Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I was going back home with Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は幽霊を信じているらしい。それはもう、
普段の萌先輩から想像も付かないくらい真剣に
……。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai said she believed in ghosts. She told me that
with a very serious face......
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai said she believed in ghosts. She told me that
with a very serious face......

dialogues.jp:
ずっと占いをしていたせいか、萌先輩は眠そう
だった。萌先輩にとっては何でもない、半分眠
りながらの帰宅。
dialogues.en:
After doing psychic reading all day, she was getting sleepy.
She was walking back home while half asleep, as usual.
dialogues.text:
After doing psychic reading all day, she was getting sleepy.
She was walking back home while half asleep, as usual.

dialogues.jp: ……そんな萌先輩に、自動車が迫ってきた。
dialogues.en: ......However, a car came running toward Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: ......However, a car came running toward Moe-sempai.
